bibliographic.title: Actions Speak Louder than Goals: Valuing Player Actions in Soccer
bibliographic.venue: Proceedings of the 25th ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery & Data Mining (KDD '19)

scope.rationale: Introduces VAEP (Valuing Actions by Estimating Probabilities), the canonical event-level action-value framework for soccer; central to the SAVANT corpus.

model.name: VAEP
model.target: V(a) = P(score in next k actions | post-action state) - P(concede in next k actions | post-action state)

evaluation.splits: Split by match per the paper's protocol; exact partitioning to be re-verified against Section 4.

claims.statement: VAEP decomposes per-action value into score-probability and concede-probability deltas, allowing offensive and defensive actions to be valued on the same scale.
VAEP discriminates between scoring and conceding outcomes better than xT-style baselines on the held-out evaluation.

limitations: Action-level supervision uses next-k-action labels, which couples per-action value to chain length.
Does not natively handle off-ball actions; only on-ball events recorded in SPADL are valued.
open_questions: Extending VAEP to incorporate tracking data so off-ball positioning can be valued.

critic.notes: Human-authored seed record used to exercise schema validation. Real records will populate source_chunks from the chunked PDF and carry a real critic verdict.
